_how_to: Real reviews only, copied as written by the traveller. Put each one in "reviews", then run: php artisan toubkal:import-reviews (or add the line to deploy/artisan-queue.txt). A review already imported is skipped.

_example.external_id: optional id on the platform, avoids duplicates
_example.author_name: First name and initial as shown on the platform
_example.title: Title of the review, if any
_example.body: The full text of the review (at least 20 characters).
